action_description: Rewrote GEMM2/down-projection as a topk-slot grouped split-K path: phase 1 writes unweighted FP32 split partials to a torch tensor workspace, and phase 2 deterministically reduces top-k and split contributions, applies topk_weights and GEMM2 bias, and casts directly to bf16 output. GEMM1/stage1 was unchanged; the out_accum memset, atomicAdd accumulation, and standalone finalize kernel were removed.
